reviews.text: I came to try the GLP1 service and everyone was very nice. The service was reasonable and the advice was enthusiastic. The doctors were very good and worked gently. I really liked it. I will support them again.

I cannot express how grateful I am to Sophia🥹❣️Even though I'm not confident in my English, she took the time to explain everything so patiently and thoroughly using a translation app. I feel truly fortunate to have found a clinic that makes me feel this safe and comfortable✨️ Since moving to Dallas, I had been waiting until my trips back to Tokyo to get my Botox and dermal fillers, but from now on, I definitely want to keep coming to Sophia😍Thank you so much for such a wonderful experience😊

It was my first visit, and everyone was so friendly and welcoming! Sophia was very thorough during the consultation and even pointed out things I hadn’t noticed myself. I really appreciated how she offered recommendations without making me feel pressured. Thanks for the thoughtful suggestions, I’m even happier with the results than I expected!

I really liked my experience and booked more treatments for myself. I did the lip filler consultation. PA Sophia did a one on one with me asking what my preference is and her recommendation to my lips to how it would fit. I was also interested in their membership and she told me what it was an in-depth explanation. I also needed to get a second session of rejuran which they had! I would honestly say the price was very reasonable and fair considering I also got a free consultation to how I want my lips to be like

It was my first time visiting SUA Glow. They are sweet and attentive. PA Sophia was detail oriented and I felt safe receiving treatment from her. I usually go to bigger cities like Los Angeles to get any Korean skin treatment done but I will revisit SUA Glow for my next treatment. Thank you Sophia!

I had a great experience at Sua Glow! I got Botox with Sophia, and she was so nice, welcoming, and professional. She took the time to explain everything clearly and made me feel very comfortable throughout the appointment. I really appreciated how knowledgeable and patient she was. I would definitely recommend Sua Glow!

Ultimate K-beauty is finally here! ✨ I had such a great experience. The consultation was very professional and thorough, with detailed explanations and personalized recommendations based on my features, preferences, and beauty goals. The prices are
reasonable, and they also offer great promotions. If you’re looking for professional, personalized K-beauty services, I highly recommend this place!

I brought my mom in for botox today, and we had a wonderful experience with Sophia.

We contacted several places before making an appointment, but Sophia was by far the kindest and most informative. She took the time to answer all of our questions, which made us feel confident about choosing her.

When we met her in person today, she was just as warm, patient, and professional. She explained everything clearly and made my mom feel completely at ease. The preparation before the injections was very thorough, and everything was clean and hygienic.

My mom said that the injector's technique is so important, and Sophia's hands were incredibly gentle and precise. The injections were much more comfortable than she expected.

We truly appreciate Sophia's professionalism, attention to detail, and genuine care. We highly recommend her to anyone considering Botox treatments!
*****

I previously left a review for my mom after her Botox treatment, and she recently went back for a touch-up. She was especially happy with the treatment for the lines on the bridge of her nose. She was very satisfied with the results.

Thank you for always taking such good care of my mom! ❤️

I also want to mention that she's extremely knowledgeable about facial anatomy and is constantly educating herself, both here and in Korea, on best practices and keeping her clients comfy! She's also extremely thorough. But I think what separates her from a lot of other people in the industry is that her priority is safety. There was a treatment I brought up that she was honest with me wasn't the best fit for my specific goals, even though it would have benefited her to just say yes. The fact that shes willing to tell me that let me know she has my best interest at heart.

Side note: They have little salmon plushies for Rejuran procedures in case it's painful for you (should be named Regina or Reggie for Rejuran imo😄).
Personally I had no issues with pain, the numbing cream was great, but I might just have a high pain tolerance. Sophia was very clear that it might be painful so I was aware going in.

Overall Sophia was a doll to work with, I'll be back to touch up!
